example.title: Mount Mitchell Heritage Prairie Historic District, Captain Mitchell Farmstead corncrib

brief: Long drive-through double corncrib about 26 ft by 36 ft, its two cribs built of widely spaced horizontal slats weathered silver-grey on a frame of heavy posts, with a central drive bay under the ridge and a plank door patched into the front. The gable roof of rusty red corrugated metal overhangs the ends; the whole thing sits up on a low concrete sill and piers, sagging a little. An old wooden railroad boxcar used for storage stands beside it among bare cottonwoods, with a garden hose and buckets in the grass.
